items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Well I worked with him a few times and I did a record with him. “We Free Kings” I believe it’s called.

ctx.x: That’s wonderful. Can you tell me about Roland Kirk, a little bit about him?

Well I worked with him a few times and I did a record with him. “We Free Kings” I believe it’s called. On the recording session that was the first time that I’d ever heard him or seen him. I’d heard about him but I’d never heard him before I saw pictures of him playing the three saxophones or three instruments at once, but I didn’t know really what to expect. So I think Jerome Richardson got me on that date somehow. Quincy Jones was still living in New York and I think he was running the jazz section for Mercury…
He was quite a force of nature almost.
